sn6.14:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || la || 2.
sn6.14:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 4.
sn6.14:2.1: Bhūtapubbam bhikkhave rājā ahosi Aruṇavā nāma ||
sn6.14:2.2: Rañño kho pana bhikkhave Aruṇavato Aruṇavatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi ||
sn6.14:2.3: Aruṇavatiyaṃ kho pana bhikkhave rājadhāniyam Sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho upanissāya vihāsi || || 6.
sn6.14:2.4: Sikkhissa kho pana bhikkhave Bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Abhibhū-Sambhavaṃ nāma sāvakayugam ahosi aggaṃ bhaddayugaṃ || || 7.
sn6.14:2.5: Atha kho bhikkhave Sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Abhibhuṃ bhikkhuṃ āmantesi || ||
sn6.14:2.6: Āyāma brāhmaṇa || yena aññataro brahmaloko ten-upasaṅkamissāma yāva bhattassa kālo bhavissatī ti || || 8.
sn6.14:2.7: Evam bhante ti kho bhikkhave Abhibhū bhikkhu Sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paccassosi || || 9.
sn6.14:2.8: Atha kho bhikkhave Sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Abhibhū ca bhikkhu seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ va bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya || evam eva Aruṇavatiyā rājadhaniyā antarahitā tasmiṃ brahmaloke pātur ahesuṃ || || 10.
sn6.14:3.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Abhibhum bhikkhum āmantesi || ||
sn6.14:3.2: Paṭibhātu brāhmaṇa taṃ brahmuno ca brahmaparisāya ca brahmapārisajjānaṃ ca dhammikathā ti || || 11.
sn6.14:3.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho bhikkhave Abhibhū bhikkhu Sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa pattissutvā brahmānañca brahmaparisañca brahmapārisajje ca dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi || || 12.
sn6.14:3.4: Tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti || ||
sn6.14:3.5: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho kathaṃ hi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammaṃ desessatī ti || || 13.
sn6.14:4.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Abhibhuṃ bhikkhum āmantesi || ||
sn6.14:4.2: Ujjhāyanti kho te brāhmaṇa brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca || ||
sn6.14:4.3: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutam vata bho kathaṃ hi nāma satthari sammukhībhūte sāvako dhammam desessatī ti || ||
sn6.14:4.4: Tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa bhiyyosomattāya brahmānañ ca brahmaparisañ ca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejehī ti || || 14.
sn6.14:4.5: Evaṃ bhante ti kho bhikkhave Abhibhū bhikkhu Sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā dissamānena pi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi || adissamānena pi kāyena dhammaṃ desesi || dissamānena heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi || dissamānena pi uparimena upaḍḍhakāyena adissamānena heṭṭhimena upaḍḍhakāyena dhammaṃ desesi || || 15.
sn6.14:4.6: Tatra sudaṃ bhikkhave brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca acchariyabbhutacittajātā ahesuṃ || ||
sn6.14:4.7: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho samaṇassa mahiddhikatā mahānubhāvatā ti || || 16.
sn6.14:5.1: Atha kho Abhibhū bhikkhu Sikhiṃ bhagavantam arahantam sammāsambuddham etad avoca || ||
sn6.14:5.2: Abhijānāmi khvāhaṃ bhante bhikkhusaṅghassa majjhe evarūpaṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā
sn6.14:5.3: pahomi khvāham āvuso brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpetun ti || || 17.
sn6.14:5.4: Etassa brāhmaṇa kālo etassa brāhmaṇa kālo
sn6.14:5.5: yaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇa brahmaloke ṭhito sahassīlokadhātuṃ sarena viññāpeyyāsī ti || || 18.
sn6.14:5.6: Evam bhante ti kho bhikkhave Abhibhū bhikkhu Sikhissa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa paṭissutvā brahmaloke ṭhito imā gāthāyo abhāsi || ||
sn6.14:8.1: Atha kho bhikkhave Sikhī ca bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho Abhibhū ca bhikkhu brahmānañ ca brahmaparisañ ca brahmapārisajje ca saṃvejetvā ||
sn6.14:8.2: seyyathāpi nāma || pa || tasmim brahmaloke antarahitā Aruṇavatiyā pātur ahesuṃ || || 20.
sn6.14:8.3: Atha kho bhikkhave Sikhī bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn6.14:8.4: Assuttha no tumhe bhikkhave Abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā ti || || 21.
sn6.14:8.5: Assumha kho mayaṃ bhante Abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā ti || || 22.
sn6.14:8.6: Yathā kathaṃ pana tumhe bhikkhave assuttha Abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā ti || || 23.
sn6.14:8.7: [Evaṃ kho mayam bhante assumha Abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassa || ||]
sn6.14:11.1: Evam eva kho mayaṃ bhante assumha Abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamanassā ti || || 25.
sn6.14:11.3: sādhu kho tumhe bhikkhave assuttha Abhibhussa bhikkhuno brahmaloke ṭhitassa gāthāyo bhāsamānassā ti || || 26.
sn6.14:12.1: Idam avoca Bhagavā || attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinandun ti || || 1.
